paragraphs.text: Hagi Village is a human village on the Towabara Plains on the plane of Kamigawa .

At some point before the end of the Kami War , a plague struck Hagi Village, and little black pock-marks dotted the body of almost every inhabitant. The plague had swept in like a summer squall, smelling of filth. Lord Takeshi Konda ordered the village quarantined, but quietly allowed no more than five healers to deal with the victims, who lay moaning in the streets, without the strength to even tend to their festering wounds. Wise-Muzzle had gone in not even thinking of the possibility that he could be infected. He didn’t remember sleeping once in the next five days; every memory he had was of faces twisted with pain and fever, arms choked with ugly sores, children crying, poultices, herbs, potions, remedies, and prayers. They lost a quarter of the village but saved three times more. When he woke up from his exhausted slumber two days later, he found he had his sixth tail.
